---
title: "What happens if we keep the quarter chord constant?"
---

{{< include _model.qmd >}}

```{python}
ENTRY_CEILING = 20.0   # s for this render, granted by the user
SOLVE_BUDGET = 15.0    # s for any one solve

ans = optimize_glider_unswept_c4(verbose=False)
sink_rate = ans["sink_rate"]
c_root = ans["c_root"]
taper = ans["taper"]
cg_x = ans["cg_x"]
```

::: {.hero}
[`{python} f"{sink_rate:.3f}"`]{.hero-value}
[m/s sink rate]{.hero-label}
:::

**Answer.** The sink rate is effectively unchanged at `{python} f"{sink_rate:.3f}"` m/s compared to the swept-leading-edge configuration. The optimal wing dimensions remain exactly the same at `{python} f"{c_root*1000:.0f}"` mm root chord and `{python} f"{taper:.1f}"` taper. The center of gravity moves aft to `{python} f"{cg_x*1000:.0f}"` mm to balance the shifted aerodynamic center.
